Carries the paired branch for phase 7 of the default-workspace-template's chat-agent split (`mngr/chat-agent-refactor-8`) into this branch: the harness-arms spec (`specs/minds-eval-harbor/harness_arms.md`) names the driver's model choice as `POST /api/chats/<chat_id>/model`.

The first-run onboarding spec (`specs/minds-first-run-onboarding/spec.md`) now describes the creation page as it is: the manifesto exchange opening every creation page, the ready turn's list of ways to start, and the hand-off of the conversation to the new workspace as its first chat before the wash.

The `just minds-test-electron-flow` recipe comment lists the full Electron flow's steps as the harness now runs them: the message goes to the welcome chat the workspace opens on, and a second chat is started from the New Tab page before the terminal step.
